test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of 10 April 2022, who among the following is the senior most minister in terms of age among the council of ministers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Som Parkash.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The average age of the new council of ministers has reduced to 58 years from 61 years previously following a Cabinet reshuffle.
 
• **Nisith Pramanik (35), the Lok Sabha MP from West Bengal's Cooch Behar, is the youngest minister **to be sworn in, while the **oldest member in the council of ministers is 72-year-old Som Parkash.**
 
• There are** 77 members **in the Council of Ministers now.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Council of Ministers:**

 
 
• The Council of Ministers is** appointed by the President **on the advice of the Prime Minister.
 
• Typically, only members of Parliament are appointed as Ministers.
 
• The Council of Ministers consists of all orders of Ministers- **Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nisith Pramanik:**

 
 
• Nisith Pramanik of Cooch Behar, 35, is the** youngest minister** in Team Modi.
 
• His real achievement lies in bringing Cooch Behar out of the shadows of Kolkata and putting it on the national map.
 
 
 
• **Sudarshan Bhagat:**
 
 
• He's an active Indian politician belonging to Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• He's a member of the Indian Parliament, and presently represents the **Lohardaga constituency.**
 
• He's the **Minister of State for Tribal Affairs **in the Narendra Modi government.
 
 
 
• **PP Chaudhary:**
 
 
• P.P. Chaudhary is the **Union Minister of State for the Law and Justice and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.**
 
• Prior to that, Chaudhary was the speaker of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on services of Profit and was also a member of the Committee on Subordinate Legislation and the Standing Committee on Personnel, Committee on Public Grievances, Law and Justice.
